source_review: Both kernels reconstruct the complete actual scalar child graph and its acyclicity independently; no producer no-external or synchronous-close flag grants authority. Actual operations exclude ownership, addresses, external calls, arbitrary callback bodies and teardown.

CallKind preserves explicit selected Suspend even for a pure body. Direct selection contradicting reachable Yield/SuspendCall rejects; ordinary Call/FunctionRef/ForeignFunctionRef/scoped thread entry cannot invoke Suspend. Await may adapt a Direct target, and the ordinary Direct machine body is retained.

Frame planning allocates a distinct physical embedded child structure and active flag per static site, including repeated uses of the same worker. Recursive type occurrence/identity reservations precede cloning/hash/rendering; duplicate worker machines reject.
Resume dispatch contains only actual saved PCs: entry, Yield continuation and Await poll. Helper Ready/tag/destroy blocks have no independent dispatch edge, preserving poll-result dominance.

Ready extraction is followed by child close/finish and active-flag clearing before continuation; the scalar result is spilled by the normal machine-value rewriting. Child init cannot run again while Pending.

Close first requests cancellation for all active descendants, then closes/destroys active direct children and marks the parent Closed. Static site order is sufficient only because sequential Await admits at most one active direct child per parent. General concurrent sibling creation order remains open.

Selected pure Suspend enables task runtime/import generation even without TaskStart or Yield. Non-None generic role life is explicitly rejected in Types/Analyze/Verify in this branch; transport support alone does not admit HRTB.
Core call_kind participates in actual Types incremental identity and selected Suspend exports use TaskInterface rather than ordinary scalar export authority.
